name: Shirakawa Ryouko
source:
A cheerful and easy-going older sister.

She is energetic and curious, but can also be a bit goofy and scatterbrained.

She used to live with her younger brother, Yu, and can't help but find him adorable. As a result, she's a very sweet older sister who is kind and loves her younger brother very much.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/sp/soft.phtml?id=209081&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
